findings.title: Remote script piped to shell
findings.description: A remote script is downloaded with curl and piped directly into a shell.
findings.impact: Remote code can execute during installation with no chance to inspect it first.
findings.recommendation: Download the script, read it, and run it explicitly instead of piping curl output into bash/sh.

findings.title: No dependency lockfile
findings.description: The repo declares dependencies but ships no lockfile.
findings.impact: Without a lockfile, installs can resolve to different (possibly malicious) package versions over time.
findings.recommendation: Commit a lockfile (poetry.lock, Pipfile.lock, uv.lock, ...) so installs are reproducible.
findings.evidence: no lockfile found alongside dependency manifest
